notes.title: Mega Man Legacy Collection Update Notes
notes.notes:
Notes for the 03/15/16 update for Mega Man Legacy Collection:


 Added sound effects to all menus
 Added support for the Japanese Rockman versions of all six games
 Added Japanese language support
 Added Japanese region detection

notes.title: Mega Man Legacy Collection Update Available Now
notes.notes:
http://images.onesite.com/capcom-unity.com/user/capkel/mega_man/mega_man_legacy_collection/136b9baf903b3c109170fde129bb0359.png?v=202200

Hey Mega Fans,
 
We've released an update for Mega Man Legacy Collection today that fixes a few minor issues, as well as adds Rockman 1 through 6 (i.e. the Japanese versions of Mega Man). If you run into any bugs or problems after grabbing the update, we encourage you to use our Crash / Bug Report Thread to let us know.
